title: PORTVS Unified Work Graph Node
description: Every artifact in the multi-agent ecosystem — memory observation, plan, IRF item, atom, pipeline entry, governance rule, convention, skill — is a node in one graph. The `phase` field is the lifting dimension that unifies what were previously four disconnected registries.

id.description: Unique node identifier. Format: {DOMAIN}-{NNN} (e.g. PLAN-042, GOV-007, MEM-301, IRF-189, CONV-001).

phase.description: Position on the ephemeral→durable axis. Transitions: ephemeral→draft→proposed→accepted→done→retired→archive. Nothing leaves the lattice — archive is the final resting state.

domain.description: What kind of node this is. Domain is emergent from phase position, not a separate taxonomy. A plan at phase=done is a record. An atom at phase=accepted is work.

version.description: Monotonic version. Increments on supersede. Enables semver evolution of governance rules, conventions, and decisions.

supersedes.description: ID of the node this version supersedes. Required when version > 1.

superseded_by.description: ID of the node that superseded this one. Set by portal-sync when a newer version is accepted.

author.description: Which agent (or human) created this node.

confidence.description: Author's confidence in this node. 0.9+ = high certainty. Used for conflict resolution when two agents produce contradictory nodes in the same domain.

scope.description: Visibility scope. 'global' = all agents. 'project:<path>' = scoped to a repo. 'agent:<name>' = private to one agent.

content.description: The node's payload — plan text, memory observation, governance rule, IRF description, convention spec, decision rationale.

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and discovery.

project.description: Optional project identifier for scoped queries.
